description: Subscribe a target channel to an announcement (news) channel, so the source's published messages are reposted into the target. The source must be an announcement channel. Requires the Manage Webhooks permission in the target. Returns a confirmation.

source_channel_id.description: ID (snowflake) of the announcement channel to follow.

target_channel_id.description: ID (snowflake) of the channel that will receive published messages.

name: discord_follow_announcement_channel
